desc: Introducing the next addition to Reptilia's line of AR pattern grips, the CQG-L Grip. The CQG-L has all of the geometry users have loved in the CQG for 4 years now, specifically designed to enhance ergonomics and performance of compact sized short-barreled rifles, AR15 pistols, pistol caliber carbines, and PDWs , with an additional 0.5" of length for those who have larger hands or prefer a longer grip.
